controls.purpose: WR08 full right-hand parameter limits composed with arbitrary filters, plus zero-operator positive residual floor and vanishing penalty.
WR08 unique minimum preimage construction, strong zero-operator correction limit despite positive residual floor, and eventual escape past each finite budget.
WR09 and WR16 arbitrary-filter parameter choices from exact minimum preimage hypotheses, explicit scaled data/solver error limits, and separate all-three-terms pointwise certificate.
At each positive parameter a scalar Hilbert operator and data 1 versus 0 attain exactly the noise gain 1/(2 sqrt(alpha)).
Reject nonnegativity in place of strict positive regularization for objective comparison; at zero the identity-operator comparison with exact datum is false.
Reject promotion of the full positive-parameter limit to a two-sided limit; the total path is zero at nonpositive parameters.
Reject closure membership in place of actual range membership for existence of a minimum preimage and strong limit.
Reject unscaled data-error decay where decay of delta/sqrt(alpha) is required.
